t: You're on Victoria Road in Kensington, a short street running south from Kensington Road, close to Kensington Palace and the Royal Albert Hall. In 2015 it was considered the most expensive street in the United Kingdom. There are sixty-four properties here, including the Embassy of Vietnam. The street takes its name from Queen Victoria, who reigned from 1837 to 1901, longer than any monarch before her. Her sixty-three years gave their name to the Victorian era, a time of great industrial, political, scientific and military change.
